pages.text: Rubies are precious gemstones used in advanced crafting. They can be processed into various forms:$(br)• Cut Ruby$(br)• Flawless Ruby$(br)• Perfect Ruby$(br)• Polished Ruby$(br)• Ruby Shard

pages.title: Cut Ruby
pages.text: Basic cut ruby used in crafting.

pages.title: Perfect Ruby
pages.text: Exceptionally pure ruby with perfect clarity.

pages.title: Polished Ruby
pages.text: Ruby polished to a brilliant shine.

pages.title: Ruby Shard
pages.text: Small fragment of ruby, used in crafting.
